failure_summary.description: Follow-ups skipped requested updates or repeated filters for cached domains whose criteria had not changed.
Values were placed in the wrong attraction fields or allergy criteria were mapped incorrectly.
Search or filter results were generated without being saved to cache.
Generated code imported tools despite the runtime contract that tools are injected directly.
An optional hotel budget was requested as required or an unspecified optional value was passed as None.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly covers cached-result scope, saving results, and the no-import runtime contract, so repeating those rules would add little. These edits clarify the under-specified mapping between attraction categories and named places and make omission of unspecified optional fields explicit, addressing schema errors without expanding the existing guidance.

edits.target: For attraction searches, use each explicitly provided location field (`city` and/or `state`) in the matching schema field along with the requested category or name.
edits.content: For attraction searches, put category/type criteria in `type` and named places in `attraction_name`; if both are requested, populate both separate fields and never put a place name in `type`. Pass city and state values to their matching fields.

edits.target: Match arguments only to fields declared by the selected tool’s schema, with the expected type and cardinality.
edits.content: - Omit optional arguments for which the user supplied no value; never pass `None` or invent placeholders. For boolean criteria, set only explicitly requested or unambiguously mapped flags; do not fill other supported options with `False`.
